clarifications_needed: size_band is null on all schema keys — the README sizes venues by seat capacity (5K+ managed / 2K+ independent) and annual visitors (500K+/100K+), which have no employee/revenue mapping; encode via list-building filters
Per-venue holiday-display budget bands ($25K–$500K+ managed, $25K–$200K independent) are inferred — no closed BN deals anchor them; update after first two contracts

Legends Global and OVG preferred-vendor qualification channels are undocumented publicly (README open research gap) — treat the managed-venue segment as hypothesis until a vendor portal or inside contact is confirmed
Geography reflects BN service territory stated in the README (UT, CO, AZ, NorCal, Seattle, FL metro, East Coast Tri-State/Philadelphia/DMV/NC; SoCal excluded)
Municipal procurement timelines (4–8 months) make municipal venues a distinct motion not yet field-tested by BN

tech_signals: ASM Global or OVG360 management credit on venue website
intent_signals: Venue RFP published for seasonal or holiday programming vendor
Job posting for Director of Events or Programming at venue
Competitor venue in same metro announced a holiday light show or seasonal activation
Venue LinkedIn page promoting dark-calendar entertainment or family events
Venue recently transitioned to Legends or OVG management (transition trigger)
New venue opening announcement within BN service territory
exclusions: SoCal venues (outside BN service territory per README)
Venues under 5K seats without major annual visitor count
Venues with active multi-year holiday-display vendor contracts

tech_signals: City or county government domain (.gov) for municipally owned venues
Independent venue website with ticketing integration (Eventbrite, Universe)
Public RFP posted on BidNet, DemandStar, or Onvia for seasonal or holiday services
Venue listed on CVB (Convention & Visitors Bureau) regional event-venue directory
intent_signals: Municipal holiday-lighting RFP published (Feb–Apr posting window per README)
Venue social media promoting upcoming holiday or seasonal event
New venue leadership hire (Director of Events, GM) — transition trigger
Competitor independent venue in same metro launched a holiday activation
Community feedback or local press on venue dark-date calendar
Venue website listing available rental dates suggesting significant dark-calendar inventory
exclusions: SoCal venues (outside BN service territory per README)
Venues under 2K seats without significant community visitor volume
Venues with active multi-year holiday-display vendor contracts
Venues requiring federal procurement compliance (military bases, federal buildings)
